$comment: Phase 8 A6 frozen generation task set. Metric: 一次生成通过 schema 编译 + 安装成功 + 覆盖期望 slug 的比率. Reproduce: pnpm bench:genui (generator selected via CU_BENCH_GENERATOR).
metricDefinition: Rate of tasks where the generated render-schema compiles cleanly, covers the expected component slugs, and installs through install-core on the first attempt.

tasks.prompt: collect email and password then submit the form
show an empty state that prompts the first action
